description: Defines the template class ConstantSymNodeImpl for representing constant symbolic nodes (bool or int64_t) in the c10 namespace, including methods for type checking, comparison, and string conversion.

classes.name: ConstantSymNodeImpl
classes.description: Template class for constant symbolic nodes, supporting bool and int64_t types, with methods for type checking, comparison, and string representation.

methods.name: is_int
methods.description: Checks if the stored value is an integer.

methods.name: is_bool
methods.description: Checks if the stored value is a boolean.

methods.name: is_float
methods.description: Always returns false; float not supported.

methods.name: guard_int
methods.description: Returns the integer value if applicable, otherwise throws an error.

methods.name: guard_bool
methods.description: Returns the boolean value if applicable, otherwise throws an error.

methods.name: guard_float
methods.description: Throws an error; float not supported.

methods.name: int_
methods.description: Returns the stored int64_t value, throws if not an int.

methods.name: bool_
methods.description: Returns the stored bool value, throws if not a bool.

methods.name: has_hint
methods.description: Indicates that this node has a hint (returns true).

methods.name: eq
methods.description: Checks equality with another SymNode.

methods.name: ne
methods.description: Checks inequality with another SymNode.

methods.name: ge
methods.description: Checks greater or equal with another SymNode.

methods.name: le
methods.description: Checks less or equal with another SymNode.

methods.name: lt
methods.description: Checks less than with another SymNode.

methods.name: gt
methods.description: Checks greater than with another SymNode.

methods.name: mul
methods.description: Multiplies with another SymNode.

methods.name: sym_and
methods.description: Logical AND with another SymNode.

methods.name: sym_or
methods.description: Logical OR with another SymNode.

methods.name: str
methods.description: Returns string representation of the stored value.

methods.name: constant_int
methods.description: Returns the stored int64_t value if applicable.

methods.name: constant_bool
methods.description: Returns the stored bool value if applicable.

methods.name: is_constant
methods.description: Indicates this node is a constant (returns true).

methods.name: is_symbolic
methods.description: Indicates this node is not symbolic (returns false).
